questions.question_en: When and where did you graduate from the university?
questions.question_cn: 你什么时候从哪所学校毕业的？

questions.question_en: Do you think the knowledge you've learned in the university helped you a lot in your work? Why or why not?
questions.question_cn: 你认为你在大学里所学的知识对你的工作有很大帮助吗？为什么？
questions.answer: Yes, I think so. Because first, it will help us to understand work SOP. Then, it will help us to form a good safety awareness. Also, the English we learned in school is very useful.

questions.question_en: What suggestions will you give to the student controllers who are at the university?
questions.question_cn: 你给在大学学习管制的学生们什么建议？
questions.answer: OK, I think they should learn English well in school. Because we are very busy at work. Use the time in school wisely.

questions.question_en: Could you please describe an event of air miss or near miss?
questions.question_cn: 请你描述一次空中危险接近事件？

questions.question_en: Why is air miss or near miss dangerous?
questions.answer: 后果类问题，同airmiss（参见OPI 1第14题）

questions.question_en: What may cause air miss or near miss?
questions.question_cn: 引起空中危险接近的原因是什么？

questions.question_en: What is the separation minima for radar control or procedure control in your control area?
questions.question_cn: 在你的管制空域中，雷达管制或程序管制的最小间隔是什么？

questions.question_en: When you discover the risk of air miss between two aircraft, what should you do immediately to avoid near miss?
questions.question_cn: 当你发现两架飞机有小于间隔的危险时，你怎样立即避免空中危险接近？

questions.question_en: What are your procedures when the separation minima seem to be exceeded?
questions.question_cn: 当最小间隔看起来要被超越时，你的标准程序是什么？

questions.question_en: Have you ever received any simulator training about hijacking? Do you think it is necessary for controllers to receive such training?
questions.question_cn: 你曾经经过任何有关于劫机的模拟训练吗？你认为接受这种训练对于管制员是有必要的吗？
questions.answer: Yes. We must have simulator training for hijack every year. I think it's very necessary, because all the controllers should know how to work with pilots during hijacking. And we must be ready for anything.

questions.question_en: When a hijacking occurs, what information should the controllers know?
questions.question_cn: 当劫机发生时，管制员需要知道哪些信息？
questions.answer: Controller should get info about the POB, endurance, number of hijackers, weapon, injuries and pilot's intention.

questions.question_en: If the hijacker wants to divert to other airport, what information should controllers provide to the flight crew?
questions.question_cn: 如果劫机者想改航去其他机场，管制员需要给机组提供什么信息？
questions.answer: If they wanted to divert, I should provide the route, weather and alternate A/P info.

questions.question_en: What help can ATC give to the flight crew in order to control the situation?
questions.question_cn: 为了控制劫机事件，管制员能给机组提供什么帮助？
questions.answer: First, we should inform Air Force and anti-hijack squad. Then, we should instruct other A/C to avoid, monitor the A/C. Also, we should inform supervisor, related ATC units and Emergency services.

questions.question_en: Do you have standard procedures for dealing with a hijacking? If yes, what are they?
questions.question_cn: 你们有处理劫机的标准程序吗？如果有，是什么内容？
questions.answer: First, I should confirm squawk 7500. Then, I should confirm the situation on board, such as POB, endurance, number of hijackers, weapon, injuries and pilot's intention. Also, I should inform Air Force, supervisor, anti-hijack squad and related ATC units. If necessary, I should instruct other A/C to avoid, issue flow control.

questions.question_en: What is the most important thing when dealing with a hijacking?
questions.question_cn: 当处理劫机时，什么是最重要的事情？
questions.answer: Follow SOP and checklist, Never provide personal advice.
